question_text: Was Peninsula Energy's Wyoming uranium mine hacked?
answer_text: Reported as a cyberattack, not confirmed as one. Peninsula Energy says a cybersecurity incident breached the control systems at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming on Nov 20. It has not said who or how. Operations are suspended.
label: Reported

question_text: Who was behind the Lance cyber incident?
what_would_settle_it: Peninsula, US law enforcement or a credible independent analysis naming who caused the incident, or saying whether it came from outside or inside the company.

question_text: Was any data taken in the Peninsula Energy incident?
what_would_settle_it: Peninsula reporting what its investigation into potential data impacts found.

question_text: When will the Lance uranium operation restart?
what_would_settle_it: Peninsula's promised update on the expected timeline for restarting operations at Lance.

question_text: Is the Lance incident linked to last week's US outages?
answer_text: Nothing public links them. None of the outages of the week before, such as the FAA ground stop, was attributed to a cyberattack, and Peninsula has not mentioned any other incident.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Peninsula, investigators or an official source saying whether the incident is connected to any other.
